privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This Privacy Policy explains what personal data Current Nexus Group Limited (“CNX”) collects through this website, how we use and protect it, and the choices and rights you have.

s1.heading: 1. Who We Are
s1.body:
This website is operated by Current Nexus Group Limited (“CNX”, “we”, “us” or “our”), a company registered in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region that manufactures and supplies solar modules, battery energy storage systems and related products.
CNX is the controller of the personal data described in this policy. You can contact us using the details on our Contact page.

s2.heading: 2. Scope of This Policy
s2.body:
This policy applies to personal data we collect through this website, including our contact, quotation, warranty and newsletter forms, and through related email and messaging conversations that start from the website.
It does not cover websites run by other companies that we link to, including the websites of Tier 1 brands we represent. Those websites have their own privacy policies.

s3.heading: 3. Personal Data We Collect
s3.body:
Depending on how you use the website, we may collect:
- Contact details: your name, job title, company name, business email address, phone or WhatsApp number and country.
- Project information: the products you are interested in, project size, location, timelines and any technical requirements you share.
- Files you upload: drawings, product lists, specifications or photos attached to an inquiry or warranty request.
- Communications: the content of messages you send us and our replies.
- Newsletter data: your email address and preferred language.
- Technical data: IP address, browser type, device information, referring pages and the pages you visit.
Please do not send us sensitive personal data, such as health information or government identification numbers, through the website.

s4.heading: 4. How We Collect Your Data
s4.body:
We collect personal data directly from you when you complete a form, request a quotation, subscribe to our newsletter or contact us by email or messaging apps.
We collect technical data automatically through strictly necessary cookies and, only if you consent, analytics cookies. We may also receive business contact details from our authorised distributors and partners when you ask them to involve CNX in your project.

s5.heading: 5. Why We Use Your Data
s5.body:
We use personal data for the following purposes:
- To respond to inquiries and prepare quotations, based on the steps you ask us to take before entering into a contract.
- To supply products and provide technical, warranty and after-sales support, to perform our contract with you or your company.
- To send newsletters and product updates you have signed up for, based on your consent.
- To keep the website secure, prevent misuse and understand how it is used, based on our legitimate interest in running a reliable website.
- To meet legal, tax, accounting and export obligations.
We do not use your personal data for automated decision-making that has legal or similarly significant effects on you.

s6.heading: 6. Cookies and Analytics
s6.body:
We use strictly necessary cookies to operate the website and remember your cookie choice. Analytics cookies are only activated after you accept them in our cookie banner, and you can change your choice at any time through the “Cookie Settings” link in the footer.
For full details, please read our Cookie Policy.

s7.heading: 7. Who We Share Your Data With
s7.body:
We do not sell or rent personal data. We share it only where needed, with:
- Service providers who host the website, deliver email and store data on our behalf, under contracts that require them to protect it.
- Authorised CNX distributors or installation partners in your region, when you ask for local support or a local quotation.
- Logistics and freight partners, when needed to deliver products you have ordered.
- Professional advisers, such as auditors and lawyers, under duties of confidentiality.
- Public authorities, courts or regulators, where the law requires it or to protect our legal rights.

s8.heading: 8. International Transfers
s8.body:
CNX serves customers and partners in many countries, and our team and service providers are located in more than one region. As a result, your personal data may be transferred to and processed in countries other than your own, including Hong Kong and mainland China.
Where we transfer data internationally, we take steps to make sure it receives an appropriate level of protection, such as contractual safeguards with our service providers.

s9.heading: 9. How Long We Keep Your Data
s9.body:
We keep personal data only for as long as we need it for the purposes described in this policy:
- Inquiry and quotation data: for the duration of our discussions and business relationship, and then for up to seven years to meet legal and accounting requirements.
- Warranty records: for the length of the product warranty, plus any period required by law.
- Newsletter data: until you unsubscribe.
- Technical and analytics data: for the period set out in our Cookie Policy.
When data is no longer needed, we delete it or make it anonymous.

s10.heading: 10. How We Protect Your Data
s10.body:
We use technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against loss, misuse and unauthorised access, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), access controls and limited staff access on a need-to-know basis.
No method of transmission over the internet is completely secure, but we work to protect your data and review our safeguards regularly.

s11.heading: 11. Your Rights
s11.body:
Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may have the right to:
- Access the personal data we hold about you and receive a copy of it.
- Ask us to correct data that is inaccurate or incomplete.
- Ask us to delete your data, where we no longer need it.
- Object to or ask us to restrict certain uses of your data.
- Withdraw your consent at any time, where we rely on consent, without affecting earlier processing.
- Complain to the data protection authority in your country.
To use any of these rights, contact us using the details on our Contact page. We may ask you to confirm your identity before we respond.

s12.heading: 12. Marketing Communications
s12.body: We only send newsletters and marketing emails if you have signed up for them or where the law otherwise allows. Every email includes an unsubscribe link, and you can also ask us to stop at any time.

s13.heading: 13. Children’s Privacy
s13.body: This website is intended for business customers and is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a child has sent us personal data, please contact us and we will delete it.

s14.heading: 14. Changes to This Policy
s14.body: We may update this policy to reflect changes to our website, services or legal requirements. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed. Where changes are significant, we will make that clear on the website.

s15.heading: 15. Contact Us
s15.body:
If you have questions about this policy or how CNX handles personal data, please contact us using the details on our Contact page.
For information about cookies, please see our Cookie Policy.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how CNX uses cookies and similar technologies on this website, why we use them, and how you can manage your preferences.

s1.heading: 1. What Are Cookies?
s1.body: Cookies are small text files that websites may store on your computer, tablet, or mobile device when you visit a website. They help websites function properly, remember your preferences, and, where permitted, understand how visitors interact with the website.

s2.heading: 2. How We Use Cookies
s2.body:
We use cookies to support the essential operation of our website and, where you have given your consent, to understand website usage and improve our content and user experience.
Cookies may be set by CNX directly (first-party cookies) or by third-party service providers whose tools are integrated into our website (third-party cookies).
We classify cookies into the following categories.

s3.heading: 2.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies
s3.body:
Strictly necessary cookies are required for the website to operate securely and function as intended. Depending on the features you use, they may be used to:
- Remember your cookie consent preferences.
- Support essential website functions and maintain secure sessions.
- Protect the website against certain security risks.
- Maintain the technical stability and performance of the website.
These cookies do not require consent where they are strictly necessary to provide a service you have requested. They cannot be disabled through our cookie preference tool, although you may be able to block them through your browser settings. Doing so may affect certain website functions.

s4.heading: 2.2 Analytics Cookies

q1.question: Can I replace old solar panels with a different model?
q1.answer: Potentially. Assess the candidate module’s dimensions, mounting details, electrical characteristics, weight and compatibility with the existing system. A qualified engineer should confirm the final design.

q2.question: Can replacement solar modules match the original dimensions?
q2.answer: CNX can review the original module dimensions and mounting details and assess whether a suitable replacement specification is feasible. Exact tolerances, available models and production capability must be confirmed for each project.

q3.question: Can I use a higher-wattage module during PV repowering?
q3.answer: Possibly, but higher wattage does not automatically mean a suitable replacement. Check module format, string current and voltage, inverter limits, structural conditions, registered capacity and local rules.

q4.question: Can I replace panels without changing the mounting structure?
q4.answer: That depends on module dimensions, frame profile, mounting-hole positions, clamp zones, weight and the condition of the existing structure. Reuse should be confirmed by the responsible technical professional.

q5.question: What information should I send for a solar panel replacement assessment?
q5.answer: Start with site location, installed capacity, installation year, original module model or datasheet, inverter model and estimated replacement quantity. Label photos and mounting details are useful if the datasheet is unavailable.

q6.question: How long does a PV module replacement project take?
q6.answer: Timing depends on specification, quantity, availability, approvals, documentation, shipping and whether site work is included. CNX will confirm an expected schedule after reviewing the scope.

q7.question: Will replacing modules affect my feed-in tariff, subsidy or permit?
q7.answer: This depends on the country, scheme, contract and exact changes to the plant. Confirm requirements with the relevant authority, network operator, contract counterparty or qualified local adviser.

q8.question: Can CNX provide installation and commissioning?
q8.answer: Installation and commissioning coordination must be confirmed for each project. The quotation should distinguish module supply from removal, recycling, installation, testing and grid-related work.

faq.heading: Solar & Renewable Energy Project Financing FAQs

q1.question: Does CNX directly provide project financing?
q1.answer: Financing availability depends on the specific commercial arrangements confirmed by CNX and the relevant financing provider. CNX can discuss equipment procurement requirements and applicable arrangements within its confirmed scope, but financing should not be assumed to be available for every project.

q2.question: What is the difference between project financing and supply chain financing?
q2.answer: Project financing focuses on funding a renewable energy project and its associated development or construction costs. Supply chain financing focuses more directly on payment and working-capital arrangements within the procurement and supply process.

q3.question: Can CNX help prepare equipment quotations for a project financing discussion?
q3.answer: We can clarify the requested equipment scope and coordinate relevant product quotations within our supply scope. Whether those quotations meet a lender’s requirements depends on the project and the financing provider.

q4.question: What information is needed to discuss potential financing arrangements?
q4.answer: The initial discussion may require project location, project stage, estimated capacity, equipment requirements, budget and schedule. Additional financial, legal or credit documentation may be required by the relevant financing provider.

q5.question: Are financing terms guaranteed?
q5.answer: No. Any financing or credit arrangement is subject to program availability, eligibility checks, credit assessment, contractual terms and required approvals.
